Job Description Summary 
As a Software Engineer – PET Data Acquisition, you will join a highly specialized team developing the real-time software stack at the core of GE HealthCare’s PET/CT imaging systems.
Our software directly impacts image quality and system reliability, enabling clinicians worldwide to provide accurate diagnoses and life-saving care.
You will work on a distributed, high-performance C++ system running on Linux, responsible for configuring detector hardware, processing high-throughput data streams, and enabling seamless integration across the scanner ecosystem. 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 About the Team 
 Our team develops the data acquisition platform powering GE HealthCare’s PET/CT scanners .
 This system:
 Configures and interfaces with detector hardware
 Receives high-rate event streams via UDP
 Performs real-time sorting and time-stamping of coincidence events
 Manages acquisition state and persistence
 Exposes control and monitoring APIs to clinical applications
 
 The platform is a distributed, multi-process, multi-threaded C++ system running on Linux , designed for deterministic, high-performance operation under demanding workloads.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop end-to-end data acquisition features , from low-level UDP capture and event processing through service layers and client APIs
 Optimize and maintain performance-critical code paths , including: Lock-free / low-contention data structures
 Thread affinity and NUMA optimization
 Zero-copy buffer management
 Deterministic real-time execution
 
 Enhance and maintain inter-process communication mechanisms , including shared memory, message queues, and service interfaces
 Work with embedded persistence layers (SQL-based) for configuration, metadata, and runtime state
 Collaborate closely with hardware, physics, and system teams to integrate new detector and system components
 Develop unit and integration tests , and actively participate in code and design reviews
 Troubleshoot complex cross-process issues using advanced debugging and profiling tools (e.g., gdb, perf, tcpdump, strace)
 Required Qualifications 
 B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 4+ years of experience in C++ development on Linux , including modern C++ (C++14/17)
 Strong experience with: Multi-threaded and multi-process systems
 Synchronization primitives, memory models, and concurrency challenges
 Inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms such as shared memory, sockets, and message queues
 
 Solid understanding of system-level programming and performance optimization
 Working knowledge of SQL / relational databases – advantage
 
 Why Join GE HealthCare? 
 In this role, you will work on a deep, high-impact codebase that directly contributes to the performance and quality of medical imaging systems used globally.
 This position offers:
 Exposure to real-time, high-performance systems at scale
 Opportunities to work across software, hardware, and clinical domains 
 Growth in both technical depth (RT systems, performance, low-level optimization) and system-level architecture 
 The chance to contribute to technology that improves patient outcomes worldwide

Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
